name: Dusk Loiter
description: Suburban home driveway at midday with harsh direct sunlight behind the subject. A person approaches the camera with strong backlight creating a silhouette effect and lens flare, face details obscured by the glare. Challenging exposure conditions typical of backlit scenarios.
